test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2022 - General Awareness(Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Medisep is a unique and comprehensive social insurance scheme. This scheme was implemented by which state government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beginning on July 1st, 2022, the Kerala Government will implement the MEDISEP scheme**, a medical insurance programme for **State Government employees,** pensioners, and their qualified family members.
 
• The **programme would offer comprehensive coverage of up to 3 lakhs in annual cashless medical assistance.**
 
• **The annual premium during the 2022–24 policy period would be Rs 4,800 + 18% GST.**
 
• **A monthly premium of Rs. 500** will be withheld from June's pay and July's pension.
 
• The state finance office has issued a directive in this regard.
 
• The **public sector insurer Oriental Insurance Company is implementing MEDISEP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MEDISEP Scheme**

 
 
• The Keralan government introduced the** Medical Insurance Scheme for State Workers and Pensioners (abbreviated as MEDISEP) insurance programme **to offer complete **health insurance coverage to all currently employed State Government employees and retirees.**
 
• All newly hired employees and their families, part-time workers, all staff members of supported schools and colleges and their families, pensioners and their wives, and family pensioners are among the beneficiaries.
 
• The **kerala Chief minister publicly launched the programme on July 1st, 2022.**
 
• The programme drew almost **2.9 million beneficiaries **and dependents within six months of its introduction, as well as** 480 hospitals**, the majority of which are in Kerala.
